items.title: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
items.description: The ban is part of a number of proposals that must be approved in parliament within 30 days.

items.title: 'I was lured into a trap': Evan Gershkovich on moment that led to 16 months in Russian jail
items.description: The US journalist says he realised he was a "a pawn in a greater game" when he was not interrogated or tortured by FSB agents.

items.title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
items.description: Two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted by settlers.

items.title: Dutch police arrest suspected member of group that claimed FBI hack
items.description: The suspect, 24, was arrested before the alleged cyber attack took place.

items.title: First female prime minister named in Morocco after winning elections
items.description: Her appointment by the king makes her only the second woman to lead a government in the Arab world.

items.title: Eiffel Tower chief to quit after female staff replaced by men during religious visit
items.description: The company that runs the Eiffel Tower said the removal of female staff during the visit earlier this month was "unacceptable".

items.title: Nigerian dances non-stop for seven days in world record bid
items.description: Crowds cheered on Ben Dancer as completed his challenge and he has now gone to hospital for a check-up

items.title: Estonia blames Russia for arson at defence company supplying Ukraine
items.description: Russia has been accused of launching sabotage attacks across a number of European Nato countries which have been helping Ukraine.

items.title: US prosecutors reopen case of alleged gang rape at Cornell University
items.description: It comes after the woman filed a civil lawsuit alleging she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in 2024.

items.title: Man charged over AI image of crocodile in Singapore reservoir
items.description: The defendant could face jail or a fine after the image sparked a search operation in the city’s largest reservoir.

items.title: French hard-right leader accuses opponents of 'total war' after claims of antisemitism
items.description: National Rally President Jordan Bardella says he will sue for libel over comments he is accused of making as a young activist.

items.title: Trump rules out joint US-China venture to develop AI
items.description: The US president continues to push back on calls to establish guardrails around artificial intelligence, arguing it will stifle growth.

items.title: Argentina threatens legal action against UK over Falkland Islands oil exploration
items.description: President Javier Milei set a two-week deadline for the Sea Lion oilfield project to be scrapped.

items.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
items.description: The storm moved ashore on the Baja California peninsula, which is a popular tourist destination.

items.title: US ban on Canadian alcohol and dairy takes effect as trade war drags on
items.description: It is the latest escalation in the Canada-US trade war after negotiations collapsed in late August, with no word on when talks may resume.

items.title: Malaysia begins controversial repatriation of asylum seekers to Myanmar
items.description: Human rights groups say some 5,000 returnees could face violence, persecution and forced conscription.

items.title: New York Times executive fatally shot by elderly in-laws, police say
items.description: Jonathan McKinsey's in-laws, who are both 77 years old, face multiple charges including first-degree murder.

items.title: Tennessee governor declines to halt execution of state's lone woman on death row
items.description: If the execution proceeds, Pike would be the first woman put to death in Tennessee in more than 200 years.

items.title: Are Trump's US government funded ads illegal?
items.description: President Trump has faced criticism after fronting adverts which were paid for by the US government.

items.title: The Frenemy: How Australia navigates superpower rivalry
items.description: Australia is increasingly concerned about China's military might - but Beijing is also its biggest trade partner.
